This test checks that the extract method refactoring works correctly when the extracted method assigns to a field.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/extract

go 1.18

-- basic.go --
package extract

import "fmt"

func _() {
    ms := MyStruct{sub: &SubStruct{}}

    ms.sub.sVar = 1 //@codeaction("ms", "refactor.extract.function", end=closeBracket, result=outer)
    ms.iVar = 1
    ms.fVar = 1.0 //@loc(closeBracket, re`ms.fVar.*`)

    fmt.Printf("%v", ms)
}

-- @outer/basic.go --
package extract

import "fmt"

func _() {
    ms := MyStruct{sub: &SubStruct{}}

    ms = newFunction(ms) //@loc(closeBracket, re`ms.fVar.*`)

    fmt.Printf("%v", ms)
}

func newFunction(ms MyStruct) MyStruct {
	ms.sub.sVar = 1 //@codeaction("ms", "refactor.extract.function", end=closeBracket, result=outer)
	ms.iVar = 1
	ms.fVar = 1.0
	return ms
}

-- model.go --
package extract

type MyStruct struct {
    iVar    int
    fVar    float32
    subVar *SubStruct
}

type SubStruct struct {
    sVar int
}
